findings.finding: observerExecution is embedded in the immutable context, contains the exact argv and a path-to-digest files map, requires all argv file operands to appear in that map, and requires the observer to read expected inputs from this same immutable context argument. Consequently the context operand must have its full-file digest inside its own bytes. The normal SHA-256 file-check semantics in the actual runner cannot construct or validate this positive fixture without a self-referential hash or an undocumented exception. This is a stable-contract defect, independent of the missing concrete grant.
findings.requiredCorrection: Specify that the exact context operand is authenticated through the already external projection.executionContextSha256/resource-amendment reference and is excluded from its own observerExecution.files digest map. Require its exact canonical operand/path and revalidate those externally committed bytes before launch. Keep all other executable/immutable input file operands hash-bound. Explicitly distinguish any output destinations from immutable input operands; their exact paths remain context-bound and their resulting bytes are parent-validated after execution. Do not introduce a normalized/self-excluding context digest without defining and reviewing that separate algorithm.
findings.expectedOutcome: Construct a complete isolated context -> projection -> votes -> amendment -> binding fixture in finite topological order without a self-digest. The actual preflight accepts that unchanged fixture, and rejects changed context bytes, substituted context operands, unpinned code/SDK/input bytes, and unauthorized output paths before observer launch.
